Fix: added src/unicode.rs with full Unicode data generated from CPython 3.13 (all non-ASCII CaseFolding C/F mappings plus all non-ASCII digit ranges), shared by the typed build (pasted into emit::PRELUDE) and the dynamic runtime (pasted into dynpy RUNTIME). `casefold` now maps to a new `ax_casefold`/`py_casefold` helper and `isdigit` uses `py_str_isdigit`. Also updated method/type/purity lists and pybridge so casefold behaves like other str methods, and added tests/lib/review_m07_casefold_isdigit.py/.expected plus changelog.d/review-m07.md. Tested: run_check passes on normal and BREVI_DYN=1 with all 40 guard programs still typed; an exhaustive sweep of every Unicode code point's casefold and isdigit hashes matched CPython in both builds, and nearby cases (ẞ, İ, Σ, ς, ᾈ, ﬀ, superscripts/circled digits) match.
